out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the 2026 FOOD permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. THIS MUST BE MADE AVAILABLE AS INDICATED ABOVE BY MAY 18TH, 2026.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE EATING A PLATE OF FOOD WITH AN OPEN CUP OF COFFEE ON THE HANDWASHING SINK AND THREE-VAT SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED. EMPLOYEES MAY NOT EAT IN THE KITCHEN. THEY MAY HAVE A CLOSED DRINK (WITH A COVER). FOOD MUST BE EATEN IN A SEPARATE AREA TO AVOID CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SOAP AVAILABLE AT THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN. LOTION IS AVAILABLE AT THIS SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. HANDWASHING SOAP MUST BE PROVIDED TO THE HANDWASHING SINK AT ALL TIMES, NOT THE THREE-VAT SINK. THIS MUST BE PLACED AND AVAILABLE AT THIS SINK BY MAY 18TH, 2026.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE’S PLATE OF FOOD ON THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: FOOD REMOVED/PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SIGN AT THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. YOU MUST PRINT A SIGN TO PROVIDE TO THIS SINK INDICATING IT MUST ONLY BE USED FOR HANDWASHING. THIS MUST BE DONE BY MAY 18TH, 2026.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN TWO-DOOR STANDING COOLER: TURKEY SAUSAGE AT 45-51F (0.5HR), PORK SAUSAGE AT 46F. OBSERVED ON COUNTER IN KITCHEN: OPEN SAUSAGE GRAVY AT 71F (.5HR) OBSERVED IN ONE-DOOR COUNTER-TOP COOLER IN BUFFET AREA: YOGURT AT 51F (0.5HR), MILK AT 51F (0.5HR).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PORK SAUSAGES DISPOSED OF. TURKEY SAUSAGES COOLED TO 41F. SAUSAGES GRAVY PUT IN COOLER. YOGURT AND MILK TO BE DISPOSED OF AFTER BREAKFAST BUFFET (3.5HR).

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED ONE-DOOR COUNTER-TOP COOLER AT 50F AND HOLDING FOOD AT 51F. OBSERVED SANITIZER EQUIPMENT TO NOT BE OPERATIONAL. FOOD WORKER STATED IT STOPPED WORKING YESTERDAY. THERE WAS NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ON SITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the ONE-DOOR COUNTER-TOP COOLER so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. You should have this set at 35F to ensure proper holding. Send me proof of repair and proper holding by May 18TH, 2026. The sanitizer equipment must be operational by May 18TH, 2026. Until then, you must pour the quaternary ammonia solution into the sink, fill with water, and ensure it is at 150-400ppm to sanitize dishes. 2 46.37(a)-(h) - Certified Food Manager, Certification Process Food managers who possess a valid certificate of passing a food safety exam shall obtain the photo identification card from ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided). A copy of the photo identification card can be faxed to the food safety section at (703) 653-9448. Failure to provide a copy of the photo identification card may result in further enforcement action. CFM ARRIVED AT THE END OF INSPECTION; HOWEVER, DUE TO NO CFM OBSERVED AT 9 DIFFERENT INSPECTIONS SINCE 2021, YOU MUST GET TWO OTHER STAFF MEMBERS CERTIFIED AS FOOD SAFETY MANAGERS. THERE MUST ALWAYS BE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ON SITE DURING HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION (BREAKFAST BUFFET AND PREPARATION). YOU MUST PROVIDE ME WITH TWO OTHER STAFF MEMBERS CERTIFIED BY MAY 18TH, 2026. SEE LIST APPROVED LIST OF COURSES PROVIDED BY EMAIL.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED CARDBOARD LINING THE SHELVING IN THE TWO-DOOR STANDING COOLER IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. ALL CARDBOARD MUST BE REMOVED BY MAY 18TH, 2026.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Sink Not Used for Handwashing
violations.observation: Handwashing aides (i.e. hand soap, hand antiseptic, handwashing signage, nail brush) was found provided at the manual warewashing sink. OBSERVED HANDWASHING SOAP DISPENSER INSTALLED ABOVE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing sink may not be used for hand washing. REMOVE THE HANDWASHING SOAP DISPENSER FROM ABOVE THIS SINK. IT MUST BE PLACED ABOVE OR AROUND THE HANDWASHING SINK ONLY. THIS MUST BE CORRECTED BY MAY 18TH, 2026.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. PIC agreed to acquire a food manager card from an accredited food manager certification process

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS provided a copy to PCI, Pic agreed to have employees read agree and sign

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employee medicine is being stored in the 2 door upright cooler over food.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Employee moved medicine so it was it was being stored below food in the 2 door upright cooler
